Hi Marcus — thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. I’m very interested in building the analytics dashboard for your DevOps monitoring tool — the feature list (real-time charts, REST API integration, auth & RBAC, responsive + dark mode) is a great fit.

A few quick questions so I can scope accurately:
1) Do you have a preferred charting library (D3.js, Chart.js, Recharts) or are you open to recommendations that simplify development and interactivity? 
2) Can you share the REST API spec (endpoints, auth method, expected throughput) or a sample response so I can estimate integration effort? 
3) For authentication & RBAC: do you already have an identity provider (OAuth/OIDC, SSO) or should I implement an app-level solution? 
4) Any design assets or a style guide to match (colors, spacing, components)?

Budget & timeline: your $5–6k budget and ~4-week timeline are reasonable depending on the exact scope. I typically split work into milestones (discovery & wireframes, core implementation, polishing & QA) — I can draft a proposed milestone plan once I have the API and auth details.

I’m available for a 30-minute call next week (Mon–Wed afternoons CST) to align on requirements and acceptance criteria. Would any of those times work for you? 

Happy to proceed once I have the API samples and confirmation on charting/auth approach.

Best,
Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer, TechCorp Inc.
